description: A repository tree (path to content) and the Markdown files the server lists in it: every .md file, case-insensitively; hidden directories, the default excluded directories, linked worktrees (a .git file starting gitdir:) and .vantageignore matches pruned; symlinks skipped (none here, since a JSON tree cannot hold one).

`listed` is what fs.ListAllFiles returned for this tree, sorted, with ExcludeDirs = config.DefaultExcludeDirs, UseIgnoreFiles = true, and the user ignore file isolated (XDG_CONFIG_HOME and HOME set to empty temporary directories). It was produced by running that code, never written by hand.
The [planning] patterns are not applied here: docs/gallery/status.md is listed although this repository's own config excludes it from planning.
Read by the server's ListAllFiles and single-path tests and by vantage-check's candidate walk test. Materialize it under a temporary directory.

tree..github/x.md:
---
status: draft
---

# Hidden directory: pruned, so absent to the single-path mode too
tree..hidden.md: # A hidden file at the root; only hidden directories are pruned
tree.docs/NOTES.MD: # Upper-case extension, still Markdown to the listing
tree.docs/dist/x.md:
---
status: draft
---

# dist is a default-excluded directory at any depth
tree.docs/gallery/status.md:
---
status: accepted
---

# Listed: [planning] exclude is not a listing rule
tree.ignored/x.md:
---
status: draft
---

# Pruned by a directory-only .vantageignore line
tree.linked/doc.md:
---
status: draft
---

# A linked worktree: pruned
tree.nested/doc.md: # A nested repository with its own .git directory is still listed
tree.odd.md/inner.md: # A directory named like a file is still walked
